_comment: CANONICAL TRIGGER VOCABULARY — the single source of truth for turning
perception labels into a patient's known triggers.
There were previously THREE independent implementations of this: one in
mobile/src/services/triggers.js, one in aws/lambda_function.py, and exact
matching in therapist_engine. They disagreed in ways that changed clinical
behaviour -- most starkly, Lambda mapped 'person' to the 'crowd' trigger
while mobile discarded 'person' as a generic label, so the same photo
matched a trigger on one path and not the other. Which engine happened to
answer therefore decided whether a patient was told they had seen their
Every implementation must read THIS file. Do not add aliases in code.
specific: seeing this word is real evidence for the concept; a match here
can reach the threshold on its own.
weak: everyday words that COULD relate but usually do not. Scored at
weak_match_factor so they cannot fire a trigger alone -- they only
reinforce a specific match. A handbag must never be reported to a
trauma patient as their trash-bag trigger.
generic: never evidence of anything; discarded before matching.
acoustic_concepts also fire from the Watch's measured sound level, because a camera cannot see a bang.
